item.coloph: yul kha cher skyes pa'i rdo rje slob spon shrad d+ha ka ra barmasa rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i thig gdab pa'i cho ga'i 'grel pa/ bod yul du skyes pa'i dge slong rin chen bzang pos gsol ba btab nas 'grel pa byes pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrad d+ha ka ra barma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsA ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos skad gsar chad kyi zhus te gtan la phab pa'o
